text: No-code UI lets marketers build audiences and journeys once schema is configured
quote: Once the schema is configured, marketers can build audiences and journeys in a no-code UI.

text: Data teams define reusable models via SQL, dbt, BI queries, or a visual builder
quote: Data teams typically create models by writing SQL in the editor, selecting from tables or views, or re-using dbt models and BI queries from Looker or Sigma.

text: Syncs run on a schedule or trigger and report the outcome of each run
quote: A sync runs on the schedule or trigger you set, then reports the outcome of each run so you can confirm it worked.

text: Sync debugger lets you inspect a run and diagnose rejected rows
quote: Check a run or debug rejected rows | Debug a sync run

text: Hightouch Events collects web, mobile, and backend behavioral data into the warehouse
quote: Hightouch Events collects customer behavior from websites, mobile apps, and backend systems, then stores that data in your warehouse.

text: Official SDKs (browser, iOS, Android, Node.js) plus an HTTP API for server-side event ingestion
quote: Hightouch provides SDKs for browser, iOS, Android, Node.js, and other platforms, plus an HTTP API for server-side ingestion

text: HTTP Tracking API records event data from any website or application
quote: Hightouch's HTTP Tracking API enables you to record data from any website or application.

text: Identity Resolution links related customer records into a single unified identity in the warehouse
quote: Identity Resolution links related customer records into unified identities in your warehouse, so every downstream product works from one consistent view of each person or account.

text: Golden Record produces a one-row-per-identity table of canonical field values via survivorship rules
quote: Golden Record — a one-row-per-identity table of canonical field values (selected by survivorship rules) that many teams use as their source-of-truth customer or account view.

text: MCP server lets an AI assistant build audiences, manage syncs, design journeys, and generate emails/ads in plain language
quote: the Hightouch MCP server connects your AI assistant directly to your marketing stack so your team can build audiences, manage syncs, design journeys, generate emails and ads, and analyze performance — all in plain language.

text: Natural-language prompts can create an audience definition and wire it to a sync destination
quote: "Create an audience of customers that added an item to their cart in the last day but haven't completed a transaction, then create a sync to Braze."

text: Ad Studio generates visual ad creatives from a prompt and refines them via follow-up instructions
quote: Ad Studio Customers: Generate visual ad creatives from a prompt, refine them with follow-up instructions, and browse existing projects.

text: REST API exposes syncs, models, sources, and destinations as manageable resources
quote: Hightouch exposes a REST API that lets users interact with resources like syncs, models, sources, and destinations.

text: AI Decisioning uses reinforcement learning to pick the best message, channel, and timing per customer and measures results
quote: AI Decisioning uses reinforcement learning to recommend the best message, channel, and timing for each customer, then measures what worked.

text: Personalizes website and app experiences in real time based on current customer behavior
quote:
Personalize in real time

Tailor website and app experiences based on what a customer is doing right now.

text: Adds extra identifiers to synced audiences/conversions so ad platforms recognize more customers
quote: Help ad platforms recognize more of your customers by adding additional identifiers to synced audiences and conversions.

text: Built-in agent lets users explore segments and analyze campaign performance in natural language
quote: Create audiences from warehouse data, build automated journeys, and use the built-in agent to explore segments and analyze campaign performance in natural language.

text: Syncs modeled data to sales, support, analytics, and internal tools on a schedule or when data changes
quote: Sync modeled data to sales, support, analytics, and internal tools on a schedule or when data changes.

text: Change-data-capture sends only new, changed, and removed rows instead of a full result set each run
quote: Instead of sending the full query result on every run, CDC compares the current results to the previous run and only sends new, changed, and removed rows.

text: Lightning sync engine computes CDC directly in the warehouse for higher-scale performance
quote: For higher performance at scale, you can enable the Lightning sync engine to compute CDC directly in the warehouse.

text: A sync maps one model's rows into one destination object, list, or table
quote: A sync connects one model to one destination object, list, or table, and describes how the model's rows map into that destination.

text: Sync alerts notify users when a run fails
quote:
Get notified when a run fails

[Configure sync alerts]

text: Tracking spec supports five event types: identify, track, page, screen, and group
quote: Events come in five types — identify, track, page, screen, and group — each for a different kind of action.

text: Git Sync allows managing workspace resources programmatically via version control
quote: Git Sync lets you manage workspace resources programmatically.

text: API requests are authenticated with an API key passed as a bearer token
quote: Authenticate each request by passing your API key as a bearer token in the `Authorization` header

text: Configurable permissions, approvals, and ownership boundaries per team
quote: Set up permissions, approvals, and ownership boundaries so each team has the right level of access.

text: Batch endpoint submits multiple events to the collector in a single request
quote: Use the batch endpoint to submit multiple events to the collector in a single request.

text: Apps can be instrumented via SDK, HTTP API, or a streaming source like Kafka or Google Pub/Sub
quote: You instrument your app, site, or backend with a Hightouch SDK, the HTTP API, or a streaming source like Kafka or Google Pub/Sub.

text: Models can be queried directly, built on in Customer Studio, or synced downstream
quote: Query these directly, build models on them in Customer Studio, or sync them downstream.
